title: NavIgAtor: Phase 2 Basket Trial of Nebaprubart in IgA-Mediated Renal Diseases
official: A Phase 2, Open-Label, Basket Trial to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability and Efficacy of Nebaprubart (JJP-1212) in Adult Participants with IgA-mediated Renal Diseases
summary: Main objective: * To characterize the safety and tolerability of JJP 1212 in participants with LN, IgAN, or IgAV-N
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Written informed consent obtained from the participant prior to performing any protocol-related procedures, including screening evaluations.
2. 12. LN: Clinical diagnosis of SLE by 2019 American College of Rheumatology and European League Against Rheumatism criteria.
3. 13. LN: Diagnosis of 2018 Revised International Society of Nephrology/Renal Pathology Society classification (active focal or diffuse proliferative LN Class III or IV) confirmed by biopsy obtained within 6 months prior to Screening or during the Screening Period. Biopsy specimens must undergo pathology review including assignment of ISN/RPS class, Activity Index (AI), and Chronicity Index (CI). Participants may co-exhibit Class V disease. Participants with de novo or relapsing disease may be eligible.
4. 14. LN: Clinically active LN at Screening requiring or receiving immunosuppressive therapy as part of an SoC regimen, in the opinion of the Investigator.
5. 15. LN: UPCR level meeting the protocol-specified criteria
6. 16. LN: eGFRcr-cys  level meeting the protocol-specified criteria, calculated using the 2021 CKD-EPI Creatinine-Cystatin equation.
7. 2. Trial participant is a male or female aged 18 through 75 years old at the time of consent. Body mass index (BMI) of 18.5 through 32.0 kg/m2 at Screening, and weight at least 45 kg and no more than 109 kg inclusive.
8. 10. IgAN/IgAV-N: Controlled and stable blood pressure (defined as <140/90 millimeters of mercury [mmHg]) over the 3 months prior to enrollment, assessed based on medical records.
9. 3. Participant has source-verified kidney biopsy-confirmed disease.
10. 4. Female participants considered of childbearing potential (WOCBP) who are sexually active must have a negative highly sensitive pregnancy test at screening and enrollment and must use a highly effective method of contraception during trial participation (at least from date of Screening) and for 4 months after the last IMP administration. A highly effective contraceptive method includes combined (estrogen and progestogen containing) hormonal contraception associated with inhibition of ovulation (oral, intravaginal, transdermal), progestogen-only hormonal anticonception associated with inhibition of ovulation (oral, injectable, implantable), intrauterine device (IUD) or intrauterine hormone-releasing system (IUS), bilateral tubal occlusion or vasectomized partner. Sexual abstinence is allowed when this is the preferred and usual lifestyle of the participant.
11. 5. Non-sterilized male participants who are sexually active with a female partner of childbearing potential must use male condom with spermicide from the time of IMP administration and for at least 4 months after the last dose of the IMP. Because male condom with spermicide is not a highly effective contraception method, female partners of a male trial participants must also use a highly effective method of contraception throughout at least for the same period.
12. 6. Able to provide an informed consent to participate in the trial and willing to comply with the requirements of the protocol and complete the trial.
13. 7. IgAN/IgAV-N: Established diagnosis of primary IgAN or IgAV-N based on kidney biopsy obtained any time prior to or during the Screening Period.
14. 8. IgAN/IgAV-N: UPCR level meeting the protocol-specified criteria during the Screening Period.
15. 9. IgAN/IgAV-N: eGFRcr-cys  level meeting the protocol-specified criteria, calculated using the 2021 Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration (CKD-EPI) Creatinine-Cystatin equation.
16. 11. IgAN/IgAV-N: Compliance with stable and optimal dose of renin angiotensin system (RAS) inhibitor treatment: a. Receiving an angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitor (ACEi) or angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) at a stable and maximal tolerated dose for at least 90 days prior to Screening, unless contraindicated or not tolerated (reason to be documented). b. Has received a sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor, or has a documented reason for not receiving it (contraindication, intolerance, or other medical reason documented by the Investigator). Participants receiving an SGLT2 inhibitor at Screening must be on a stable dose for at least 90 days prior to Screening. c. No planned changes to ACEi/ARB or SGLT2 inhibitor therapy during the study. d. Prior treatment with other therapies approved for IgAN is not required.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Diagnosis of co-existing chronic kidney disease other than IgAN, IgAV, or LN.
2. 17. History of severe drug-induced allergy/hypersensitivity or ongoing clinically important allergy/hypersensitivity, as judged by the Investigator or history of hypersensitivity to drugs with a similar chemical structure or class to JJP-1212.
3. 18. For 12 weeks (or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer) prior to enrollment: * Immunoglobulin therapy * Calcineurin inhibitors (e.g., cyclosporin, voclosporin, tacrolimus), mechanistic target of rapamycin inhibitors, retinoids, thalidomide, lenalidomide * Janus kinase inhibitors * IV cyclophosphamide >2 pulses of high dose (≥0.5 gm/m2) or >4 doses of low-dose (500 mg every 2 weeks) * Alkylating agents other than cyclophosphamide (e.g., chlorambucil) * Cytokine or cytokine receptor antagonists * Belimumab, abatacept, or eculizumab * Other biologics used for immunosuppression or immunomodulation
4. 2. Concomitant significant renal disease other than LN, IgAV, or IgAN (e.g., diabetic kidney disease, membranous nephropathy) on the most recent kidney biopsy prior to or during the Screening Period. Note: Hypertensive vascular changes are acceptable.
5. 19. For 24 weeks prior to enrollment: * B cell-depleting therapies (e.g., rituximab, ocrelizumab, ofatumumab, inebilizumab, telitacicept, atacicept, or obinutuzumab) * Receipt of systemic glucocorticoids (i.e., oral, rectal, IV, or intramuscular) for more than a total of 2 weeks for any concurrent illness, including asthma, inflammatory bowel disease, or drug-induced SLE.
6. 20. A positive pregnancy test or breastfeeding for female participants.
7. 21. Women using hormone replacement therapy (HRT) unless they agree to stop HRT at least 4 weeks before enrollment and start using highly effective methods of contraception.
8. 22. Live or attenuated vaccine within 1 month of enrollment visit and until the EoT visit.
9. 23. An active infection, or history of serious infection within the preceding 1 month at Investigator’s discretion.
10. 24. Individuals with a history of malignancy, except for adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer, carcinoma in situ of the cervix, or other malignancies treated with curative intent and without evidence of recurrence for at least 5 years prior to Screening.
11. 25. Positive or indeterminate tuberculosis (TB) QuantiFERON test performed within 35 days prior to Day 1 (dosing).
12. 9. History of dialysis within 12 months prior to signing the informed consent form (ICF) or expected need for renal replacement therapy (dialysis or renal transplant) within a 12-month period after enrollment.
13. 26. Involvement of any JJP Biologics or contract research organization (CRO) employees directly involved with the trial or their close relatives.
14. 27. Judgment by the Investigator that the participant should not participate in the trial if he/she has any ongoing or recent (i.e., during the screening period) minor medical complaints that may interfere with the interpretation of trial data or are considered unlikely to comply with trial procedures, restrictions, and requirements.
15. 28. History of bone marrow or solid organ transplantation.
16. 33. IgAN and IgAV-N: Kidney biopsy MEST or MEST-C score of T2 or C2 from the Oxford IgAN classification schema. Note: If MEST-scoring was not performed, the presence of >50% tubulointerstitial fibrosis, or crescents in >25% of glomeruli is exclusionary.
17. 29. Participation in the previous JJP-1212 studies.
18. 30. Vulnerable participants (e.g., incarcerated people).
19. 31. IgAN and IgAV-N: eGFRcr-cys level meeting the protocol-specified criteria on Screening calculated using the 2021 CKD-EPI Creatinine-Cystatin equation.
20. 32. IgAN and IgAV-N: Diagnosis of rapid progressive glomerulonephritis as measured by eGFR loss at level defined in the Protocol prior to or during the Screening Period.
21. 34. IgAN and IgAV-N: Diagnosis of secondary forms of relevant disease, as defined by the treating physician (e.g., minimal change disease with IgA deposits, infection associated IgAN, or IgAN-associated with hepatic cirrhosis).
22. 35. Treatment with systemic corticosteroids at a dose exceeding 20 mg/day prednisone equivalent for more than 14 consecutive days, or treatment with other systemic immunosuppressive agents, within 6 months prior to Screening, except for stable renal-directed background therapies explicitly permitted by the protocol and meeting the applicable eligibility and concomitant medication requirements.
23. 10. Any of the following laboratory results at Screening (tests may be repeated once within the same Screening Period to confirm results prior to enrollment): * Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) >2.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN) * Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) >2.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN) * Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) > 2.5 × ULN * Total bilirubin > 1.5 × ULN (unless due to Gilbert’s syndrome) * Platelet count <50,000/μL (or < 50×109/L) or <25,000/μL (< 25×109/L) if due to active SLE * Hemoglobin <8 g/dL (or < 80 g/L) or <7 g/dL (<70 g/L) if due to active SLE * Total lymphocyte count <200 cells/mm3
24. 36. LN: eGFRcr-cys  level meeting the protocol-specified criteria on Screening calculated using the 2021 CKD-EPI Creatinine-Cystatin equation.
25. 37. LN: The following medications must be discontinued prior to the day of enrollment for participants on MMF due to potential interaction with MMF: * Methotrexate * Azathioprine * Leflunomide * Mizoribine * Cholestyramine
26. 3. Presence of nephrotic syndrome as defined in the Clinical Study Protocol.
27. 4. Diagnosis of Type 1 diabetes.
28. 5. Uncontrolled type 2 diabetes, as evidenced by a screening HbA1c value >8% (64 mmol/mol).
29. 6. Uncontrolled blood pressure (>160 millimeters of mercury [mm Hg] systolic or >100 mm Hg diastolic).
30. 7. Participant has a history of a chronic autoimmune neurodegenerative disorder such as multiple sclerosis.
31. 8. History of any clinically important disease or disorder that, in the opinion of the Investigator, may either put the participant at risk because of participation in the trial or influence the results or the participant’s ability to participate in the trial, e.g., history of any clinically significant disease suggesting immunodeficiency or abnormal immune function or history or presence of clinically significant gastrointestinal, cardiac, pulmonological, psychiatric, coagulation, hepatic, or renal disease or any other condition known to interfere with absorption, distribution, metabolism, or excretion of monoclonal antibodies.
32. 38. LN: History or presence of a solitary kidney or a functionally solitary kidney, including congenital absence of one kidney, prior nephrectomy, severe unilateral renal atrophy, or other conditions resulting in reliance on a single functioning kidney.
33. 11. Participant’s serum Ig values meet the following criteria: * IgG ≤700 mg/dL * IgM ≤40 mg/dL * IgA ≤70 mg/dL
34. 12. Any positive result on Screening for HBsAg, HBcAb, HCVAb, and HIV. A positive hepatitis B surface antibody (HBsAb) alone is not exclusionary.
35. 13. Any clinically important abnormalities in the 12-lead ECG as considered by the Investigator.
36. 14. Known or suspected history of drug abuse in the last 1 year, as judged by the Investigator.
37. 15. History of drug or alcohol abuse or excessive intake of alcohol within the last 1 year, as judged by the Investigator.
38. 16. Positive screen for alcohol at screening prior to the first administration of the IMP.
